subject.title: fix #95295: [Bug]: Web UI sidebar hides existing child-spawned subagent sessions across agent scopes

question: Should this bug be fixed with a sidebar-only default-off All agents toggle, or should maintainers require a broader Sessions-table/gateway visibility model?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and avoids protocol/config/storage changes, but it chooses a UX and visibility boundary that automation should not decide over the broader sibling.

options.title: Land sidebar-only mode
options.body: Keep default scoped behavior, add explicit sidebar All agents discovery, and require redacted live sidebar proof before merge.

options.title: Use broader visibility model
options.body: Prefer the broader sibling if cross-agent child sessions should also appear in the Sessions table or become a general sessions-list concept.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Defer or close this candidate if maintainers do not want another sidebar scope control in core UI.

recommendation.title: Land sidebar-only mode
recommendation.body: Keep default scoped behavior, add explicit sidebar All agents discovery, and require redacted live sidebar proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged sidebar architecture and session-discovery UX work make this the best available routing owner for the scope choice.
